verses.ya-rabbana-d-khilna-wa-adkhilan-kujak-c1: yā rabbanā dkhilnā waʾadkhilan kujak kadhā mani ntamā ʾilayhim jannatak
wāʿfu ʿani l-kulli faʾinna l-ḥamda lak ʿafwā yukhaṣṣu mālikā wamā malak
wāghfir lahum jamīʿa mā khaṭṭa l-malak min dhanbihim thumma ʿfu ʿamman qad halak
wahab lanā min bintihim naslā salak sabīla rushdi fāʾizā fawza l-malik
wamallikannī ʾumma ghayri mushtarak fīhā faʾanta llāhu lā sharīka lak
